title.rendered: CCRA donates to Multiple Myeloma Research Foundation in Tribute to Paul Dickey, N6JOX SK

content.rendered:
During our October 28th CCRA breakfast it was decided by the membership to make a $100 donation to the Multiple Myeloma Research Foundation in tribute to Paul Dickey, N6JOX who died September 10, 2017.  Paul had been a long time member, had started a Boy Scout Troop in Moraga and was an active member in his church and community.

The members of the CCRA also decided to make individual contributions that would be included with the CCRA donation.  12 of our members dug into their pockets and contributed an additional $210.  The CCRA thanks them for their generosity.

On November 2nd a check for $310 was sent to the MMRF in Norwalk, Connecticut.

Thank you Paul for your time with us…
